jy-01: saurāṣṭre somanāthaṃ ca śrīśaile mallikārjunam | ujjayinyāṃ mahākālamokāramamaleśvaram ||
jy-02: paralyāṃ vaidyanāthaṃ ca ḍākinyāṃ bhīmaśaṅkaram | setubandhe tu rāmeśaṃ nāgeśaṃ dārukāvane ||
jy-03: vārāṇasyāṃ tu viśveśaṃ tryambakaṃ gautamītaṭe | himālaye tu kedāraṃ ghuśmeśaṃ ca śivālaye ||
jy-04: etāni jyotirliṅgāni sāyaṃ prātaḥ paṭhennaraḥ | saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ smaraṇena vinaśyati ||
